issues.description: Attribute mismatch for 'numberOfInscribedStudents': the problem statement UML (problem_statement.md line 65) declares numberOfInscribedStudents as int, while the solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 7) declares it as long. As a result the solution's getTotalNumberOfStudents() method (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 75) is declared to return int but returns the sum of a long and an int, causing a compilation error. This inconsistency between the UML and the solution will confuse students about the expected type and can make the reference solution uncompilable.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type for numberOfInscribedStudents consistent across artifacts. Option A (simpler): change the solution to declare numberOfInscribedStudents as int (update field, constructor parameter, getter/setter, and any calculations) so it matches the UML and keep getTotalNumberOfStudents() returning int. Option B: if large counts are intentional, update the problem statement UML and all method signatures to use long for numberOfInscribedStudents and change getTotalNumberOfStudents() to return long (and update template and solution accordingly). Apply the chosen change consistently in problem_statement.md, the template Lecture.java, and the solution Lecture.java so students see a single, compilable API.
